summary.intent: Decide whether Phase 72 needed discussion before planning, reconcile todo drift across Phases 70/70.1/71 vs 72/73, check for cross-phase dependencies, then plan/execute/ship Phase 72 followed by Phase 73.
summary.outcome: Retired 8 stale-but-shipped Phase 71 todos to completed/, folded zeroize and coderabbit-backlog todos into Phase 72/73 source lists, confirmed 72→73 must be sequential (shared client.ts churn), then paused Phase 72 planning mid-CONTEXT.md-write to diagnose and fix two live CI regressions (web-e2e via PR #600, desktop fuse via PR #601) plus a flaky sdk-e2e test, all pending merge at session end.

repo: This repo retires todos by moving pending/ → completed/ (as git renames), not into a resolved/ folder — resolved/ is empty/unused despite existing.
ci-e2e.yml (bundles Web E2E + Desktop E2E mount tests) triggers only on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch, never on PRs — PR checks give no e2e runtime proof for e2e-touching fixes.
Separate desktop-e2e.yml and web-e2e.yml support workflow_dispatch with a 'ref' input, usable to validate a fix branch pre-merge without waiting for post-merge main.
gh workflow dispatch requires `--ref <branch>` on this repo, not `-f ref=<branch>` — the workflow definition on main predates that input form.

Production rotation-floor state lives in IndexedDB `cipherbox-rotation-state` v2, single `rotation-floor` store keyed by nodeId, value `{generation?, seq?, wrappedKeyCheckpoint?}` — Phase 70.1 collapsed the prior two-store (`generation-high-water`+`seq-high-water`) layout into this.

Phase 71's IPNS anti-equivocation gate rejects same-sequence republish with a different CID (400) but allows same-CID same-seq idempotent republish (200) — concurrent first-publish tests must accept both a (200,409) split and a (200,200) idempotent outcome.

code.finding: Anti-equivocation gate: same-sequence republish with a different CID → BadRequestException; same-CID re-sign stays idempotent.

publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on the first-publish branch gated only by 'inode cid empty', so a dropped/stale UploadComplete retry re-seals at seq=1 with a new CID and trips the API's equivocation gate. Fixed by resolving IPNS first and routing a Found result into the existing CAS-bump publish path instead of skipping.
resolve_ipns_for_replay helper signature used as the model for the content_ops.rs fix.
Existing resolve-first idiom; its Found guard skips entirely (no-op case), which differs from content_ops.rs's need to route Found into a CAS-bump publish.
Test helper still probed old (pre-70.1) IndexedDB store names, short-circuited, and returned floors.generation as undefined — a stale test, not a product durability bug.
Phase 70.1 collapsed the two legacy high-water stores into a single rotation-floor store (source of the test's staleness).

Test 21 (D-06 concurrent first-publish) asserted exactly one 200 + one 409, which is non-deterministic under Phase 71's same-CID idempotency; rewritten to accept either (200,409) or (200,200) while still rejecting 5xx or missing winners.

workflow: When CI failures interrupt mid-task work with uncommitted state, stash the in-progress changes and switch to main/clean branches for the fix rather than mixing unrelated work on one branch.
For huge CI logs, fan out diagnostic subagents to extract failing tests/error signatures/culprit commits instead of pulling full logs into the main context.
Verify an agent-proposed patch against the real source (function signatures, schema, in-scope variables) before applying it, even when the agent's root-cause analysis is precise.
When a PR's own e2e checks don't run automatically, use workflow_dispatch against the fix branch to get real runtime validation before merging rather than merging blind.
A failure in an unrelated CI leg on a small PR (e.g. sdk-e2e failing on a web-e2e-only diff) is worth diagnosing separately rather than assumed to be caused by the diff.

friction: gh workflow dispatch -f ref= silently rejected; had to discover and switch to --ref <branch> instead.
SDK E2E failure reported on PR #600 was actually a pre-existing Phase 71 test flake unrelated to the PR's diff, requiring extra diagnosis to rule out.
ci-e2e.yml's push/dispatch-only trigger meant neither fix PR got automatic e2e validation, forcing manual workflow_dispatch runs before merge could be trusted.
Phase 72 CONTEXT.md drafting was interrupted mid-write by the CI failure report, requiring a stash-and-branch-switch detour.
Desktop E2E job was absent from PR #601's check list because it's dispatch-gated — not obvious until explicitly checked, could have led to merging without runtime proof of the fuse fix.
